name: Adams Rural Electric
takeaway: REC serving Adams, Brown, Highland, Pike counties. Cannot sell competitive electric — co-op members are locked in. Gas supply through Columbia Gas may be available for commercial accounts.
hook: Is your electric through the co-op or a regular utility?
notes: One of 25 Ohio electric cooperatives powered by Buckeye Power Inc. Headquarters: West Union, OH.

name: Buckeye Rural Electric
takeaway: One of Ohio's largest RECs — 18,562+ members across 9 southern counties. Cannot sell competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through Buckeye Rural or a utility like AEP?
notes: Serves Athens, Gallia, Jackson, Lawrence, Meigs, Pike, Ross, Scioto, Vinton counties. HQ: Rio Grande, OH.

name: Butler Rural Electric
takeaway: REC in SW Ohio, embedded in Duke Energy and AES Ohio territory. Address verification required — rural commercial accounts on this co-op cannot be sold competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through Butler Rural Electric or Duke Energy?
notes: Serves Butler, Preble, and surrounding SW Ohio counties near Cincinnati. HQ: Oxford, OH area.

name: Carroll Electric
takeaway: REC in Carroll, Harrison, and parts of Stark/Tuscarawas. Rural commercial accounts exempt from retail choice. HQ in Carrollton.
hook: Are you on Carroll Electric or Ohio Edison out there?
notes: Serves Carroll, Harrison, Columbiana, Jefferson, Tuscarawas, Stark county rural portions. HQ: Carrollton, OH.

name: Consolidated Cooperative
takeaway: Central Ohio REC covering Morrow, Knox, Delaware, Marion, Richland, Licking county rural areas. Exempt from retail choice.
hook: Is your power through Consolidated Co-op or AEP in this area?
notes: HQ: Mount Gilead, OH. Formerly Consolidated Electric Cooperative.

name: Darke Rural Electric
takeaway: Rural co-op in Darke, Shelby, Miami, Mercer, Montgomery county rural areas. AES Ohio and Pioneer territory overlaps here — verify utility from bill.
hook: Is the electric bill through the co-op or Dayton Power & Light?
notes: Serves Darke/Shelby/Miami/Mercer/Montgomery rural portions. Overlaps with AES Ohio and Pioneer Electric service areas. HQ: Greenville area.

name: The Energy Cooperative
takeaway: Large central Ohio REC — also offers natural gas and propane to members. Electric exempt from retail choice but gas supply may be competitive opportunity.
hook: Do you get your gas and electric through The Energy Cooperative?
notes: Serves Licking, Knox, Coshocton, Muskingum, Holmes county rural areas. Formerly Licking Rural Electrification. HQ: Newark, OH. Note: co-op also offers natural gas — verify if commercial gas is through co-op or Columbia Gas.

name: Firelands Electric
takeaway: N Ohio REC serving 9,100+ accounts in Ashland, Erie, Huron, Lorain, Richland, Sandusky counties. Cannot sell competitive electric — but gas supply may apply in Columbia Gas territory.
hook: Are you on Firelands Electric or Ohio Edison out there?
notes: 995 miles of distribution lines. Serves rural portions of Ashland, Erie, Huron, Lorain, Richland, Sandusky counties. HQ: Norwalk, OH.

name: The Frontier Power Company
takeaway: Small NW Ohio cooperative serving Wood, Sandusky, Hancock county rural pockets. Toledo Edison territory overlaps here — verify from bill.
hook: Is this address on Frontier Power or Toledo Edison?
notes: Small REC in Wood/Sandusky/Hancock rural areas. HQ: Weston, OH area. Address verification especially important in this region.

name: Guernsey-Muskingum Electric
takeaway: E-Central Ohio REC covering Guernsey, Muskingum, Morgan, Noble, Perry, Coshocton county rural areas. AEP Ohio is the IOU neighbor here — verify from bill.
hook: Is your electric through the co-op or AEP out there?
notes: HQ: New Concord, OH. Serves rural portions of Guernsey, Muskingum, Morgan, Noble, Perry, Coshocton counties.

name: Holmes-Wayne Electric
takeaway: NE Ohio REC serving Holmes, Wayne, Tuscarawas, Coshocton rural areas. Ohio Edison territory surrounds this co-op — address check critical for any Wayne/Holmes county commercial lead.
hook: Is your electric through Holmes-Wayne Electric or Ohio Edison?
notes: HQ: Millersburg, OH. Heavy Amish/farm-country territory. Embedded within Ohio Edison service area — commercial addresses need bill verification.

name: Logan County Electric
takeaway: Central Ohio REC serving Logan, Champaign, Auglaize, Hardin, Union county rural areas. AES Ohio and AEP both border this territory.
hook: Is your electric through Logan County Electric or a utility company?
notes: HQ: Bellefontaine, OH. Serves rural Logan, Champaign, Auglaize, Hardin, Union counties.

name: Lorain-Medina Rural Electric (LMRE)
takeaway: NE Ohio REC embedded in NOPEC / Ohio Edison territory. Rural commercial accounts in Lorain and Medina counties may be LMRE, not Ohio Edison — critical address check before pitching NOPEC aggregation.
hook: Is the electric bill through Lorain-Medina Electric or Ohio Edison?
notes: Shares management federation with North Central Electric. Serves Lorain, Medina, Ashland, Wayne county rural portions. HQ: Oberlin area. NOPEC does NOT cover LMRE customers.

name: Mid-Ohio Energy
takeaway: North-central Ohio REC serving portions of Richland, Crawford, Marion area rural customers. Cannot sell competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through Mid-Ohio Energy or Ohio Edison?
notes: Serves north-central Ohio rural areas. Verify exact county coverage — overlaps with Ohio Edison and North Central Electric territory.

name: North Central Electric
takeaway: Large N Ohio REC — 9,600 members across 8 counties. Toledo Edison and Ohio Edison both border this territory. Address check mandatory.
hook: Are you on North Central Electric or one of the FirstEnergy utilities out there?
notes: Serves Crawford, Hancock, Huron, Richland, Sandusky, Seneca, Wood, Wyandot counties rural portions. HQ: Attica, OH. Management federation with LMRE.

name: Paulding-Putnam Electric
takeaway: NW Ohio REC in Paulding, Putnam, Defiance, Van Wert county rural areas. Cannot sell competitive electric. Gas supply may be available.
hook: Is your electric through Paulding-Putnam Electric or Toledo Edison?
notes: HQ: Paulding, OH. Serves Paulding, Putnam, Defiance, Van Wert county rural portions.

name: Pioneer Electric Cooperative
takeaway: W-Central Ohio REC serving Shelby, Auglaize, Logan, Miami, Champaign, Mercer, Darke county rural areas. Embedded in AES Ohio and AEP territory — always verify from bill.
hook: Is the electric through Pioneer Electric or Dayton Power & Light?
notes: HQ: Piqua, OH. Explicitly confirmed that county aggregation ballots do NOT affect Pioneer co-op members. Serves rural W-central Ohio counties.

name: South Central Power
takeaway: One of Ohio's larger RECs — serves Fairfield, Hocking, Perry, Morgan, Muskingum, Athens, Vinton county rural areas. AEP Ohio borders this territory.
hook: Is your electric through South Central Power or AEP?
notes: HQ: Lancaster, OH. Serves central-southern Ohio rural counties. AEP Ohio is the dominant IOU neighbor.

name: Tri-County Rural Electric
takeaway: NW Ohio REC in Defiance, Williams, Fulton, Henry county rural areas. Toledo Edison territory borders this co-op. Cannot sell competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through Tri-County Electric or Toledo Edison?
notes: HQ: Defiance, OH. Serves Defiance, Williams, Fulton, Henry county rural portions. Explicitly confirms: co-op members are NOT affected by township aggregation ballots.

name: Union Rural Electric
takeaway: Central Ohio REC in Union, Delaware, Marion, Logan, Champaign county rural areas. AEP Ohio borders this territory.
hook: Is the electric through Union Rural Electric or AEP?
notes: HQ: Marysville, OH. Serves Union, Delaware, Marion, Logan, Champaign county rural portions.

name: Washington Electric
takeaway: SE Ohio REC in Washington, Morgan, Noble, Monroe, Meigs county rural areas. Cannot sell competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through Washington Electric or a utility company?
notes: HQ: Marietta, OH. Serves rural SE Ohio counties along the Ohio River corridor.

name: Ohio Valley Electric Cooperative
takeaway: SE/S Ohio REC serving Jackson, Gallia, Vinton, Ross, Pike, Scioto county rural areas. Cannot sell competitive electric.
hook: Is your electric through the co-op or AEP out here?
notes: Note: distinct from Ohio Valley Electric Corporation (OVEC), which is a wholesale generator. HQ: Jackson, OH area.

name: Midwest Energy & Communications
takeaway: Michigan-based cooperative that serves some NW Ohio rural members near the MI border. Exempt from Ohio retail choice.
hook: Is the electric on a co-op or Toledo Edison in this area?
notes: HQ: Cassopolis, MI. The only non-Ohio based co-op in the Buckeye Power family. Serves select border areas in NW Ohio near Michigan line.
